sentence: Direct tests are beginning just outside the corpus: on 570 Spanish manufacturing firms, Vaillant et al. find that AI platforms raise cooperative and capability-building behavior along the solution delivery process
passage: [Vaillant et al. (2025), abstract] "Data collected from 570 Spanish manufacturing firms in 2023 reveals that firms utilizing AI platforms exhibit greater cooperative and situating capability-building behavior during the problem identification and solution implementation stages."

gemini.note: The passage reports a correlational finding ('exhibit greater') whereas the sentence makes a causal claim ('raise').
